label: OFFICIAL_DOCUMENTED
meaning: Matches a first-party NASA/NOAA/ESA/GEE page or peer-reviewed paper; URL + access date stored

label: SOURCE_DERIVED
meaning: Computed deterministically from an official dataset (e.g. cell areas from Natural Earth polygons)

label: RUN_TESTED_LOCALLY
meaning: Code executed here on stated inputs; synthetic unless the input is real

label: SIMULATED_DEMO
meaning: Synthetic numbers for layout or method tests; never a result

label: PROPOSED_UNVALIDATED
meaning: Idea or method not yet validated on held-out real data
